verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth documents syncing tokens through the user's own iCloud or Google Drive. It frames this mainly as protection against phone loss. On a computer, the browser extension does not hold synced tokens; it pairs with the phone, which must confirm each request. missing for 10: evidence of simultaneous automatic sync across phone, tablet and computer, cross-platform sync between iOS and Android, standalone desktop token access without the phone, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Synchronize your Tokens with 2FAS export files, iCloud or Google Drive.
You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive to protect yourself from losing Tokens in case of phone damage or loss.
Click the browser extension icon when you need to enter a 2FA token, then confirm in the mobile app.
The 2FAS Auth browser extension pairs with your phone to deliver 2FA tokens where you sign in
